notes.title: The Zima Demo has been released in preparation for Steam Next Fest!
notes.content: In the Zima Demo you'll be able to fully clear the first of 3 hand made underground dungeons and face the first boss, Temple Guardian Chuvar. Slash your sword, shoot your bow, thrust your spear, toss your boomerang, and cast your staff to destroy the corruption! When you're tired of combat, spend some time gathering logs for the furnace or upgrading your home.
